integrity_notes: Proof reconstructed from stationary moment equations and two-state spectral decomposition; 960 finite matrix-exp comparisons and two independent event-driven numerical checks supplement but do not replace the proof. No independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Rigorous for the stationary two-state Markov-modulated scalar overdamped harmonic diffusion with additive Brownian noise, one positive stiffness, and a linear response to an additive drift force not affecting switching. The exact positive-time defect, peak, and integrated sum rule follow from two-state moment and spectral identities. No claim for non-Markov switching, multiplicative noise, variable mobility, nonlinear potentials, or alternative forcing conventions. A broader fluctuation-response theorem might already imply the calculation; independent scientific and priority audit has not been performed.
title: A strictly signed fluctuation–response defect in a randomly switching harmonic trap
